items.title: Super Micro Slides 7% Despite Gartner’s $957 Billion AI Server Forecast; Dell Falls 4%, Hewlett Packard Enterprise Dips
items.summary: Gartner just pointed to a near trillion dollar AI server market, yet Wall Street is selling the very companies that build the machines. A sudden shake-up at the top of the chip world explains why, and one server maker looks far more exposed than its rivals.

items.title: AI-Optimized Server Spending To Reach Nearly $957B In 2027, Says Gartner — Global AI Spending To Cross $4T
items.summary: Gartner expects AI infrastructure to account for 59% of global AI spending next year, driven by expanding computing workloads and rising server prices.

items.title: Nebius Group (NBIS) Gets Gartner Backing Through A $13 Million AI Platform Win
items.summary: Nebius Group (NasdaqGS:NBIS) technology underpins Plurai's new AI agent simulation platform, which has gained recognition from Gartner. Plurai recently raised US$13m in seed funding to roll out its simulation infrastructure, built with NVIDIA and Nebius Group. The platform is used by major enterprises for AI model evaluation and is positioned as a key tool for AI observability. items.title: The Overlooked AI Trade Hiding in a Beaten-Down Corner of the Market
items.summary: Consulting stocks have slumped this year on fears that AI will replace them. But the newest jobs report shows companies hiring consultants at the fastest pace in nearly two years.

items.title: Tencent (SEHK:700) Lands Gartner Leader Spot In First Edge Distribution Ranking
items.summary: Tencent Holdings (SEHK:700) said Tencent Cloud has been named a Leader in Gartner's first Magic Quadrant for Edge Distribution Platforms. The inaugural Gartner report evaluates global providers of edge distribution platforms, including content delivery and application acceleration services. Gartner's Leader placement reflects its assessment of Tencent Cloud's execution capabilities and product vision in edge distribution platforms. items.title: IonQ Named Market Shaper in Gartner’s 2026 Emerging Market Quadrant for Quantum Computing
items.summary: IonQ (NYSE:IONQ) announced that it has been positioned as a Market Shaper in Gartner’s inaugural Emerging Market Quadrant for Quantum Computing – Established Vendors, published in November 2026. The report evaluates established vendors operating in the developing quantum computing market, including their ability to deliver and support quantum systems in commercial environments.

items.title: Gartner (IT) Stock Still Looks Cheap On A 54% Three Year Slide

With investors reacting to shifting expectations around growth and AI driven disruption, the key issue for you is how the cash flow story lines up with where the price now sits. items.title: Gartner (IT) Maps Out 2027 AI Trends That Could Shape Enterprise Tech Budgets
items.summary: Gartner (NYSE:IT) released its top strategic technology trends for 2027, focusing on emerging AI and digital architectures. The firm highlighted large quantitative models aimed at regulated sectors such as financial services, healthcare, and government. Gartner also pointed to advanced speech reasoning models and AI context platforms as key technologies it expects enterprises to assess.
